To solve this problem, we need to determine how many seconds it takes for a ball to travel before hitting an object. The video shows a ball moving from left to right, and it is hitting an object at the right side of the screen. We need to find the time it takes for the ball to travel from its starting position to the point where it hits the object.

From the video, we can see that the ball starts at the left side of the screen and moves to the right. The ball hits the object at the right side of the screen. We can see that the ball is moving at a constant speed, so we can use the distance traveled by the ball to find the time it takes to hit the object.

The distance traveled by the ball is the distance from the left side of the screen to the right side of the screen. The screen is 1000 pixels wide, so the distance traveled by the ball is 1000 pixels.

The speed of the ball is 100 pixels per second. Therefore, the time it takes for the ball to travel 1000 pixels is 1000 / 100 = 10 seconds.

Therefore, the ball travels 10 seconds before hitting an object.

Answer: \boxed{10}
